summary: Brightstar Lottery PLC, a UK-incorporated NYSE-listed foreign private issuer (the successor name to International Game Technology), filed a Form 6-K disclosing open-market repurchases under its previously announced $500 million program dated July 1, 2025. The company bought 543,881 ordinary shares across two settlements — 370,200 delivered October 30, 2026 at $9.23–$9.60, and 173,681 delivered November 4, 2026 at $9.48–$10.24 — for an aggregate $5,207,078.40. Shares are held in treasury. No board recommendation or advisor named; watch pacing against the authorization and any acceleration signal.
